svg.title: Mediator
svg.desc: Mediator. Route the interactions between objects through one mediator, so many-to-many dependencies become one-to-many. Step 1, Everyone talks to everyone: Each widget calls the others: 4 × 3 = 12 references. A fifth widget makes 20 and edits all four. Step 2, Talk to the mediator: Each widget knows only the mediator and notifies it; the mediator holds the rules and calls widgets. Step 3, One change, coordinated: Thailand: the mediator sets 5 digits, reloads shipping, disables Pay. Typing 10110 then enables Pay. Step 4, Costs, and cousins: Every rule lands in the mediator: split it before it is a god object. At scale: sagas and hub-spoke.

g.text: Three classes switch Pay on and off, so no one place holds the rule.
A gift-wrap checkbox adds 8 references and edits all four classes.
if (sender === giftWrap) { shipping.reload(code) } // only CheckoutMediator changes
The cost: every new rule lands in CheckoutMediator, which can grow into a god object. Split it by area (address, payment); keep the widgets dumb.
vs Observer: often built on notifications, but one object holds the rules
vs Facade: colleagues know and call it; a facade’s subsystem doesn’t
Sagas: an orchestrator is the mediator; choreography is the mesh
Hub-spoke network: spokes peer with one hub, not with each other
